decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight builds directly on the firm's existing lighting and electrical equipment know-how, so management can interpret its first-year results and keep improving it rather than abandon it after only one year on the market.

The LED ceiling luminaire is closely related to the firm's core luminaire knowledge, which gives it the absorptive capacity to learn from early market feedback and refine the product, so dropping it shortly after launch would waste that accumulated knowledge.
